# Top 10 Best Running Shoes for Women 2026

Women-specific running shoes feature narrower heels adjustable arch support and cushioning tuned for lighter body weight. After extensive testing we present the top 10 running shoes designed specifically for women in 2026.

## Quick Comparison Table

| Rank | Product | Price | Type | Weight | Rating |
|------|---------|-------|------|--------|--------|
| 1 | Nike Pegasus 40 Women | $130.00 | Neutral Daily | 8.5oz | ★★★★★ |
| 2 | Brooks Ghost 15 Women | $140.00 | Neutral Cushioned | 9.1oz | ★★★★★ |
| 3 | ASICS Gel-Nimbus 25 W | $160.00 | Max Cushion | 10.0oz | ★★★★★ |
| 4 | Hoka Clifton 9 W | $145.00 | Light Cushion | 8.3oz | ★★★★☆ |
| 5 | New Balance 1080v12 W | $165.00 | Premium Cushion | 9.0oz | ★★★★☆ |

## Our Top Pick: Nike Pegasus 40

The Pegasus 40 womens edition features a contoured footbed and updated ReactX foam for improved energy return. The breathable mesh upper provides excellent ventilation during summer runs.

**Price:** $130.00 | **Best for:** Daily training and long-distance comfort
